guidelines.title: RoValra Guidelines
guidelines.message:
By using RoValra, du agree to follow our Terms of Use. Failure to follow these rules may Ergebnis in the suspension of access to specific features, including Status bubbles und pronouns.

Key Takeaways:
• Du kann nicht direct users off-platform.
• Du kann nicht do anything inappropriate.
• Du muss not violate the Roblox Terms of Service.

Read mehr at rovalra.com/tou.

review.requestMessage:
It looks like du've been getting value von RoValra!
 Would du mind leaving a review?
 It helps keep RoValra kostenlos für everyone without paywalls.
review.donationMessage:
Running features such as the Region selector isn't kostenlos, und RoValra completely relies on donations to cover those costs.

Donating helps us keep the servers running so features like dies kann stay kostenlos für everyone.

fortyMethod.ownerAccount: Owner Konto: The Gruppe Eigentümer CANNOT be the same Konto du sind buying items mit. The Eigentümer should be a secured alt Konto mit 2FA aktiviert und a strong, unique password.
fortyMethod.payouts: Payouts: Only the Gruppe's Eigentümer Konto kann pay out the saved Robux von the Gruppe's funds.
fortyMethod.pendingRobux: Pending Robux: Be aware das after using dies feature, the Robux wird be pending für approximately one Monat before they kann be paid out.
fortyMethod.groupRequiredBody: To use the 40% method mit dein own Gruppe, du need a Gruppe das du kann manage Experiences in.
fortyMethod.groupRequiredImportant: Important: For dies to work correctly, the Gruppe muss be owned by a secure alternate Konto. Your main Konto (the one du're using to buy items) should haben a role mit permissions to erstellen und manage Gruppe Experiences.
fortyMethod.groupRequiredDonate: If du don't haben a suitable Gruppe, du kann instead unterstützen RoValra by using our Experience to process the Kauf, which wird give RoValra the saved Robux ❤️
fortyMethod.ownershipBody: The 40% method wird not work if du sind the Eigentümer of dies Gruppe. Bitte auswählen a different Gruppe oder transfer ownership to a secured alt Konto.
fortyMethod.experienceAcceptedSpecific: Only specific Experiences work. Ensure dies Experience ist set up mit the erforderlich scripts to handle in-Spiel Käufe.
fortyMethod.experienceAcceptedGroup: Make sure the Experience belongs to a Gruppe you control, but ist not owned by dies account. Preferably the Gruppe should be owned by an alt. If du own the Gruppe, the 40% method wird not work.
fortyMethod.experienceAcceptedPending: The saved Robux wird be pending für roughly one Monat before payout. Use a secure alt as Gruppe Eigentümer für payouts.
fortyMethod.createExperienceBody: Erstellen a neu Experience für dies Gruppe to use the 40% method.
fortyMethod.createNewExperienceBody: To erstellen a neu Experience für dies method:
fortyMethod.createStepOne: Öffnen the uncopylocked Experience in Studio:
fortyMethod.createStepTwo: In Studio, go to File > Spiel Einstellungen > Security > Turn on "Allow Third Party Sales" > File > Publish to Roblox As...
fortyMethod.createStepThree: Auswählen dies Gruppe von the Ersteller list.
fortyMethod.createStepFour: Click Create und the Experience wird be published
fortyMethod.createPublishedBody: Once published, click the button below und we'll automatically find und auswählen it für du.
fortyMethod.saveSettingsUnavailable: Failed to speichern Einstellungen. Storage API nicht verfügbar.
fortyMethod.groupsLoadFailed: Failed to load Gruppen. Bitte refresh und try erneut.
fortyMethod.noGroupSelected: No Gruppe selected. Bitte versuche es erneut.

info.title: RoValra-Informationen!
info.desc1: RoValra ist an extension das's trying to make basic quality-of-life features kostenlos und accessible to everyone by making everything completely öffnen-source.
info.desc2: Some kostenlos features still rely on RoValra servers und Kosten money to run.
info.desc3: Supporter donations help cover those costs, letting RoValra keep mehr features kostenlos für everyone while continuing to improve over Zeit. <icon style="color:#c13ad9" filled>heart</icon>
info.desc4: RoValra ist a passion project und hat always been one.
